user_review.method: First-user walkthrough plus actual final-wheel installation, offline CLI and fake-provider/real-FFmpeg execution. Synthetic fixtures and structural review signatures are test inputs, not participant approvals. This is not independent user research.

scenarios.request: Continue permitted footage using a lower-cost source-video route.
scenarios.expected: Install the exact runtime and produce an audio-complete labeled export.
scenarios.observed: Installed wheel passed seven new tests with fake provider and real FFmpeg. Normal execution produced playable labeled MP4 and verified full waveform coverage; repeat reused jobs/uploads. These are local pipeline checks, not paid model or human-quality review.

scenarios.request: Try a two-second clip under a $0.10 cap.
scenarios.expected: Count the 40-second video minimum before uploading or submitting.
scenarios.observed: Video blocked after fixture TTS; zero video uploads or POSTs. Formula returned $0.20 for two seconds and $0.31 for sixty seconds at the fake $0.005/sec quote.

scenarios.request: Retry an uncertain video submission without a request ID.
scenarios.expected: Keep reservation and do not submit again.
scenarios.observed: Fake SubmissionUnknown followed by execute made no second video POST; pending reservation stayed held.

scenarios.request: Reuse one uncropped shot for two speakers or omit source review.
scenarios.expected: Block ambiguous source mapping before spending.
scenarios.observed: Offline validation rejected equal source hashes for distinct speakers, absent single-speaker review and absent motion-reuse acknowledgement. Docs require exactly one visible face throughout the shot; the CLI does not claim automatic face detection.

scenarios.request: Receive a shortened protection tail or alter the cached driver.
scenarios.expected: Require complete original speech and immutable paid specs.
scenarios.observed: Local waveform tests accepted 2.24 seconds for complete two-second speech and rejected 1.5 seconds. Changed padded-driver hash blocked without another fake POST. New route requires raw correlation >0.90, <=80ms offset, every sample and quiet tail.

scenarios.request: Install outside the checkout and use default production.
scenarios.expected: Use the bound wheel, preserve offline default and stale-review protection.
scenarios.observed: Full dependency installation succeeded in a fresh external directory. Installed module origin, CLI brief, offline produce and stale-review rejection passed with zero paid calls; no ledger was created.

scenarios.request: Open the new input contract from the standalone root README.
scenarios.expected: A published README link must resolve to the nested skill resource.
scenarios.observed: Pre-release packaging walkthrough found a root-relative references link would break after publication. Replaced it with the exact standalone nested resource URL; remote presence is verified by the publisher.

similar_skills.learned: Exact endpoint schema/pricing checks, structured results and async identity matter. Smart routing can defeat reproducible comparisons.
similar_skills.reason: Keep current-quote checks and original-ID GET recovery in the existing runtime; reject an extra CLI and automatic route switching around unknown jobs. No third-party code copied.

similar_skills.learned: Recipes connect task-specific inputs, endpoint sequences and explicit quality checks; animated portraits differ from existing-video lip sync.
similar_skills.reason: Added focused source-video contract with one-face shots, explicit motion reuse, audio verification, cost formula and perceptual limits, preserving existing avatar default. No third-party code copied.
